ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Extremely low; the visible surface is predominantly composed of low-intensity (black) pixels with a macro-level ratio of approximately 1:20 high-intensity (white) to low-intensity pixels.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: High-contrast contiguous geometric blobs are localized exclusively at the distal extremities (left and right tips) of the fluke; the remainder of the 2D spatial area exhibits a homogeneous low-intensity black pigmentation mapping.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped notch; calculated interior angle is approximately 35-40 degrees with a vertical pixel depth representing approximately 12% of the total fluke height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Highly irregular trailing edge topography; the right lobe exhibits high-frequency serrations with sharp peaks (pixel amplitude 5-10px), while the left lobe shows lower-frequency, more rounded undulations.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave mathematical curve fitted to the central trailing edge transitioning into a distinct upward convex sweep toward the distal lobe tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Spatial detection of multiple circular/ring-like pixel clusters (rosettes) scattered across the mid-region of both lobes; appearing as subtle low-contrast variations against the dark pigment.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Prominent clusters of white, calcified barnacles localized on the trailing edge of both distal tips; right tip shows a higher density of localized high-intensity pixel clusters than the left.
other_distinctive_markers: Visible white water spray and cavitation at the ventral-peduncle interface obscuring the lower boundary of the fluke lobes.
